Lu-a-Jalla

Overview

Lu-a-Jalla is a young Joon and At-Zako’s beloved. On Ingos she is sought as the missing Princess. Diera imprisons her, believing her a rival for the governor’s affection, although Lu-a-Jalla says she loves only At-Zako. Zak brings her to Tka Rik and continues searching for her lover. Their reunion comes when Zak’s true identity is revealed, but the Joon Curse still threatens their future. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Lu-a-Jalla beneath the mines

The former punishment cell is empty. Zak follows the trail deeper into the Forbidden Catacombs until he finds Lu-a-Jalla, who first mistakes him for another captor. She has escaped the mercenaries and found protection through the ancient treaty between Joons and Wormheads. She rejects the nickname Princess and explains that Diera imprisoned her out of jealousy over the governor. Zak falls in love with her, but she remains faithful to At-Zako, who drew the Joon Curse away from her. Zak promises to respect that bond. They return to Tka-Rik, and the next mission becomes the search for her missing beloved on Suslanger. [5, 6, 7, 8, 1]

At-Zako: the search turns back on itself

Tka-Rik initially expects Zak to bring the missing Joon with him. Lu-a-Jalla defends the exhausted traveller, and Zak insists that he will continue for her sake even if reunion with At-Zako means losing her. The amulet changes everything: Tka-Rik discovers that its destination was Gipath. Only Zak arrived there in that unusual way. The man he has been seeking is himself, hidden by the Khadaganian transformation spell. Restored as At-Zako, he reassures Tka-Rik and reunites with Lu-a-Jalla. The memories of their earlier flight explain why the return of his identity also brings back the danger of the Curse. [2, 9, 10, 3]

The battle with the Joon Curse

The hurried transformation that concealed At-Zako nearly destroyed his memory. Tka-Rik cannot safely repeat it, so hiding as Zak is no longer an answer. He offers another choice: flee again under his temporary protection, or confront the Curse on Gipath. At-Zako chooses to defend his life with Lu-a-Jalla. Tka-Rik supplies ancient Joon equipment and joins him in the catacombs for the final battle. Defeating the Curse completes the campaign. [4, 11, 12, 13]
